import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long n, c1 = 0, c2 = 0, answer = 0;
    static long[] power = new long[20], sumArr = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] buckets = new ArrayList[10];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void performQuery(long p, long s) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            long val = ((s - p * power[i]) % 998244353 + 998244353) % 998244353;
            answer = (answer + val * buckets[i].size() + sumArr[i]) % 1000000007;
            int idx = lowerBound(buckets[i], 998244353 - val);
            long count = buckets[i].size() - idx;
            answer = (answer - count * 998244353) % 1000000007;
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static void generateNumbers(long x, int depth) {
        long tmp = ((c1++ - x) % 998244353 + 998244353) % 998244353;
        sumArr[depth] = (sumArr[depth] + tmp) % 1000000007;
        buckets[depth].add(tmp);
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generateNumbers(x * 10 + digit, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process(long x, long n) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if ((x + 1) * 1000000L <= n + 1 && x * 10000000L > n) {
            performQuery(x, c2);
            c2 += c1;
        } else {
            answer = (answer + ((c2++ - x) % 998244353 + 998244353) % 998244353) % 1000000007;
            int startDigit = (x != 0) ? 0 : 1;
            for (int i = startDigit; i <= 9; i++) {
                process(x * 10 + i, n);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        generateNumbers(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buckets[i]);
        }
        power[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 12; i++) {
            power[i] = power[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        process(0, n);
        System.out.println((answer + 1000000007) % 1000000007);
    }
}
